text: Replace pointwise binary cross-entropy with within-user pairwise BPR updates, sampling one positive and one negative impression from the same user per training pair while skipping users lacking either class; retain the existing additive user/item logits and select the checkpoint by validation GAUC proxy.
rationale: This directly optimizes within-user ordering and should improve the official primary objective, especially GAUC and nDCG@5, without changing the model representation. Evaluate primary first, then inspect classification F1, precision, recall, and Matthews correlation; ranking diagnostics including MAP@5, MRR@5, Recall@5, and HitRate@5; and positive rate, score spread, and score extrema to detect sampling imbalance or score collapse.
